$comment: git-cli single source of truth: version = upstream git version (independent semver). Binaries are NOT committed; CI builds libgit_cli.so and tools/provision.mjs deploys it. The current entry is a DRAFT placeholder: size/sha256 are pinned by the first real CI build. See docs/000-工程规划.md.

builtFrom.deps: zlib / libcurl / OpenSSL statically linked (https transport); NO_TCLTK / NO_GETTEXT / NO_ICONV / NO_REGEX (bionic gaps covered by bundled compat)
builtFrom.assets: git templates + CA bundle shipped as AAR assets
builtFrom.ndk: TBD (first CI build pins NDK line + version)

matrix.execPackaging: useLegacyPackaging=true (extractNativeLibs=true): exec requires physical files in nativeLibraryDir; targetSdk>=29 SELinux forbids exec from app data dirs
matrix.note: Exec-form tool; https remotes need the bundled CA bundle injected via env (SSL_CERT_FILE / GIT_CONFIG); ssh remotes need a separate ssh binary (out of scope here). No pairing with other repos: version = git upstream version.
